requirement: Apply an update-metric-rule command to an existing rule: reject a command that sets both or neither of the score function and major/minor flag, reassign the criterion, refresh UpdatedAt, and update the score function or the weight according to the rule type.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed with a formula mapper
The clinical variables are supplied as mapper dependencies

inputs.text: Score function referencing an unknown variable
Command that sets both a score function and IsMajor
Command that sets neither a score function nor IsMajor
Scoring command applied to a major/minor rule
Scoring command with a ternary formula referencing a supplied variable
Major/minor command applied to a scoring rule
Scoring command that keeps the criterion

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with the updated rule
The criterion is replaced and UpdatedAt is refreshed
A scoring rule gets the mapped score function; a major/minor rule gets the requested flag
Failure with BadRequest when the formula references an unknown variable

exception_text: NotImplementedException from the dependency-less overload; ArgumentException when both or neither of the score function and flag is set; InvalidCastException when the command type contradicts the stored rule type
